comment: The probability sliders are normalised against their total at Moira.cpp:222-230, which is what makes them relative. The voltage knobs change job when their jack is patched: getVoltageAt at lines 486-497 then uses the knob as a gain between 0 and 1 taken from its -10V to +10V scale, so a knob left at its default 0V halves the patched voltage rather than passing it through. The auxiliary choice is drawn from a second reading of the same noise 300 units further along the phase (AUX_OFFSET, line 214), so it is not an independent random source. The crossfade curve at lines 44-49 is a cubic ease in and out.
